'''Haren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Second Infantry]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] he was stationed at [[Port Pevaria]] in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="Scrambled Signals" />
